$comment: Generated by sdk/contract/generate-avatar-voice.mjs from lib/avatar-state.ts (the web engine's hand-over rules). Do not edit by hand. A frame event carries the raw frame; read it with the SDK's own avatar frame reader (avatar.json).

scenarios.name: a face nobody can see is held, never watched
held, then shown: it connects, plays, and takes the voice at a gap
no hand-over while either voice speaks; it takes the voice once both are quiet
a face level the platform cannot read does not stop the hand-over
stalled: no new frame for 2 s gives the voice back at once; frames for 1 s return it to waiting
the third stall ends the face for the call
a stall longer than the patient limit (45 s) ends it
no first frame 25 s after it was ready: it never shows
the call ending after a failure clears its reason for the next call
a face that goes silent while the call's voice speaks loses the voice for the call
a face heard while the call speaks keeps the voice
unavailable while live: the call's voice comes back at once
an unknown reason reads as error; ended reads as ended
the call ending takes the face with it
taken off screen while live: held again, the voice back with the call; shown again it reconnects
blocked (the platform will not play it aloud): the call keeps the voice until it plays
the same face again is nothing new; another face replaces it
